text_block_list.text:
Today, Грасс Вандер will finally run in
her debut
race!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She takes deep and slow breaths,
outwardly
seeming like her usual self.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But I can't help but wonder if she'll be
able to
hold it all together. Is she
warmed up enough?
Should I tighten her
shoelaces?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Excuse me, Тренер? You seem to be
rather
anxious. Are you feeling okay?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You're nervous enough for the
two of us.
I'm doing just fine.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
A journey of a thousand miles begins
with a single
stЭпизод Today is no different
than any other.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
We've waited a long time for this
debut... I'll show
you a performance that
will be sure to clear away
those nerves.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Well, I should be on my way.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
